verdict.rationale: SAM.gov is a government data platform with public REST APIs, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents only REST endpoints reached through a browser or a client such as Postman, plus a downloadable OpenAPI spec. Nothing shows a first-party command-line tool; the APIs and spec are developer building blocks, not a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
